en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road with cyclists and pedestrians in front of late 19th–early 20th century buildings. On the right stands a church with a tall, pointed bell tower; to its left is a long hall-like building, and further left a structure with a crenellated tower. Residential and civic buildings line both sides of the street. The top of the card bears printed German text identifying the location.
